constructionPressure.label: PBS construction input items, year on year

assumptionBasis: Directional scenarios compare housing demand pressure with verified available-area coverage. Population growth is a driver, not a city-level numerical forecast in this release.
method: Index(year) = 100 × (1 + annual scenario rate / 100)^(year − 2026). Rates are transparent scenario inputs, not a fitted forecast.

drivers.title: Housing demand
drivers.text: Asking-price and rental observations provide a directional demand signal for established cities.

drivers.title: Available areas
drivers.text: Verified area and segment coverage is used as a supply proxy. Missing areas are not treated as zero supply.

drivers.title: Population growth
drivers.text: Population growth increases household formation pressure. City-level population inputs are not imported here, so this driver remains qualitative.
